messages:
maria: quick sync — we need to lock the initial AWS/GCP/Azure packaging + legal checklist for the marketplace listing. goal: publish staging offers by EOD Friday. uploaded the SKU spreadsheet and the trial flow doc: https://drive.redwood/example-marketplace-packages :eyes:
aj: saw the doc, thanks. question: do we need separate SKUs per region or one SKU with entitlements?
kevin: partners said a regionized SKU is preferred for billing in EU. i can add region suffixes (e.g., redwood-inference-prod-eu) if that helps ops.
sarah: for trials we should use a single trial SKUs mapping to a trial entitlement, easier for analytics. can we do mapping instead of duplicate SKUs?
maria: preference is to avoid SKU explosion. kevin — can you do region tag in metadata but keep one SKU for the storefront? that satisfies finance + partner ops.
kevin: yep I can add metadata. quick config snippet i plan to use for publisher manifest:
```
{"sku":"RED-INF-BASE","metadata":{"regions":["us","eu","apac"],"trial_entitlement":"RED-INF-TRIAL"}}
```
legal-team: flagged the EULA localization and data residency clauses. need a short form for Azure and a longer form for AWS due to marketplace requirements. i've added comments in the doc.
maria: thx legal. prioritized items?
legal-team: 1) confirm KMS key ownership wording for private customers, 2) confirm telemetry opt-out wording, 3) localized EULA for DE/FR.
aj: KMS wording — we should call out customer-managed KMS only for Private deployments. Hosted/Dedicated will reference Redwood-managed keys. i can add a line.
kevin: on the packaging side, we also need the AMI/container image tags and a manifest checksum. i'll push the asset manifest to the repo: https://git.redwood/marketplace/manifests (PR incoming).
gcp-bot: build pipeline passed for manifests/2026-03-21 — digest: sha256:abcd1234
sarah: one more ops ask — we need a rollback playbook for each marketplace (simple steps: unpublish, revoke trials, update consumers). can someone draft?
maria: @aj can you draft rollback playbook for AWS + Azure? i'll do GCP. keep it to 6 steps max so support can follow.
aj: on it. i'll reuse our staging runbook and post a pared-down version.
kevin: estimated time to finish metadata + manifest edits: 2 hours. will ping when PR is ready.
maria: awesome. goal recap: kevin edits + PR, legal resolves three flagged items, aj drafts rollback, sarah finalizes trial mapping. check-in in ~1.5h. :handshake:
aj: noted.
legal-team: will send EULA snippets by EOD.
sarah: prepping trial telemetry metrics to validate once staging is live.
maria: thanks team — ping here when done or if blockers.
